business_outcome: Prevent Factory teams from being treated as complete when workflow coverage hides missing professional disciplines or correctness-only QA.
existing_owner_scan: Factory Core v1.2 already owns team compilation and topology governance; professional capability completeness is therefore an extension of the existing Factory Core rather than a new team.
duplication_analysis: No separate team is justified. G2.5 belongs in the existing compiler between structural design and G3 eligibility and reuses the existing governance path.
residual_unowned_loop: Portfolio remediation remains open: legacy teams must be re-audited and missing canonical packages reconciled even after the compiler prevents new post-cutover gaps.
